title: "Find combinations of ecosystems"

To analyse the biomass within meta-ecosystems in our experiment, we require a dataset where each row represents a connected or unconnected meta-ecosystem at a specific time point (`ds_metaecosystems`). To do so, we need to identify which ecosystems to combine in unconnected & connected meta-ecosystems (storing combinations in `ecosystem_combinations)` and then sum the biomass of combined ecosystems (from `ds_ecosystems`) into `ds_metaecosytems` by going through the following steps. (1) Identify the combinations of ecosystems that constitute connected meta-ecosystems. This allows us to know the biomass of which ecosystems to sum. (2) Determine the ecosystem IDs of unconnected ecosystems. This allows us to then create unconnected meta-ecosystems. (3) Identify the combinations of ecosystems that constitute unconnected meta-ecosystems. This allows us to know the biomass of which ecosystems to sum. (4) Bind connected and unconnected meta-ecosystem combinations. (5) Create ds_metaecosystems.

```{r meta-ecosystems-create}

## - (1) Identify the combinations of ecosystems that constitute connected meta-ecosystems. - ##

combinations_connected = ds_ecosystems %>%
  
  # To have the information about to which system nr and metaecosystem type each ecosystem belongs, we select one of the time points to don't have multiple informations of the same ecosystem.
  
  filter(time_point == 0,
         
         # To create only combinations for connected metaecosystems, we filter the combinations of only connected ecosystems
         
         connection == "connected") %>%
  select(system_nr,
         metaecosystem_type,
         ecosystem_ID) %>%
  
    # To know which ecosystems were combined to for the connected meta-ecosystem, assign the ecosystem ID to the first and second ecosystems as mean ± 0.5. This is because the two ecosystems of a meta-ecosystem are two integers next to each other (e.g., 31 and 32). 
  
  group_by(system_nr,
           metaecosystem_type) %>%
  summarise(ID_first_ecosystem = (mean(ecosystem_ID) - 0.5),
            ID_second_ecosystem = (mean(ecosystem_ID) + 0.5)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r}

## - (3) Identify the combinations of ecosystems that constitute unconnected meta-ecosystems. - ##

combinations_small_s = crossing(ID_unconnected_small_autotrophic_s,
                                ID_unconnected_small_heterotrophic_s) %>%
  mutate(metaecosystem_type = "S unconnected (fixed)") %>%
  rename(ID_first_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_small_autotrophic_s,
         ID_second_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_small_heterotrophic_s) %>%
  select(metaecosystem_type,
         ID_first_ecosystem,
         ID_second_ecosystem)

combinations_small_medium_s = crossing(ID_unconnected_small_medium_autotrophic_s,
                                       ID_unconnected_small_medium_heterotrophic_s) %>%
  mutate(metaecosystem_type = "SM unconnected (fixed)") %>%
  rename(ID_first_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_small_medium_autotrophic_s,
         ID_second_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_small_medium_heterotrophic_s) %>%
  select(metaecosystem_type,
         ID_first_ecosystem,
         ID_second_ecosystem)

combinations_medium_large_s = crossing(ID_unconnected_medium_large_autotrophic_s,
                                ID_unconnected_medium_large_heterotrophic_s) %>%
  mutate(metaecosystem_type = "ML unconnected (fixed)") %>%
  rename(ID_first_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_medium_large_autotrophic_s,
         ID_second_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_medium_large_heterotrophic_s) %>%
  select(metaecosystem_type,
         ID_first_ecosystem,
         ID_second_ecosystem)

combinations_large_s = crossing(ID_unconnected_large_autotrophic_s,
                                ID_unconnected_large_heterotrophic_s) %>%
  mutate(metaecosystem_type = "L unconnected (fixed)") %>%
  rename(ID_first_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_large_autotrophic_s,
         ID_second_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_large_heterotrophic_s) %>%
  select(metaecosystem_type,
         ID_first_ecosystem,
         ID_second_ecosystem)


combinations_small_sd = crossing(ID_unconnected_small_autotrophic_sd,
                                ID_unconnected_small_heterotrophic_sd) %>%
  mutate(metaecosystem_type = "S unconnected (relative)") %>%
  rename(ID_first_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_small_autotrophic_sd,
         ID_second_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_small_heterotrophic_sd) %>%
  select(metaecosystem_type,
         ID_first_ecosystem,
         ID_second_ecosystem)

combinations_small_medium_sd = crossing(ID_unconnected_small_medium_autotrophic_sd,
                                       ID_unconnected_small_medium_heterotrophic_sd) %>%
  mutate(metaecosystem_type = "SM unconnected (relative)") %>%
  rename(ID_first_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_small_medium_autotrophic_sd,
         ID_second_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_small_medium_heterotrophic_sd) %>%
  select(metaecosystem_type,
         ID_first_ecosystem,
         ID_second_ecosystem)

combinations_medium_large_sd = crossing(ID_unconnected_medium_large_autotrophic_sd,
                                ID_unconnected_medium_large_heterotrophic_sd) %>%
  mutate(metaecosystem_type = "ML unconnected (relative)") %>%
  rename(ID_first_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_medium_large_autotrophic_sd,
         ID_second_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_medium_large_heterotrophic_sd) %>%
  select(metaecosystem_type,
         ID_first_ecosystem,
         ID_second_ecosystem)

combinations_large_sd = crossing(ID_unconnected_large_autotrophic_sd,
                                ID_unconnected_large_heterotrophic_sd) %>%
  mutate(metaecosystem_type = "L unconnected (relative)") %>%
  rename(ID_first_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_large_autotrophic_sd,
         ID_second_ecosystem = ID_unconnected_large_heterotrophic_sd) %>%
  select(metaecosystem_type,
         ID_first_ecosystem,
         ID_second_ecosystem)

combinations_unconnected = rbind(combinations_small_s,
                                 combinations_small_medium_s,
                                 combinations_medium_large_s,
                                 combinations_large_s,
                                 combinations_small_sd,
                                 combinations_small_medium_sd,
                                 combinations_medium_large_sd,
                                 combinations_large_sd) %>%
  
  # To have a system nr for all the unconnected meta-ecosystems, give them a nr that starts from 1000, so that they can be distinguished from the connected meta-ecosystems. 
  
  mutate(system_nr = 1001:(1000 + nrow(.))) %>%
  select(system_nr,
         metaecosystem_type,
         ID_first_ecosystem,
         ID_second_ecosystem)
```

```{r echo=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
expect_equal(nrow(combinations_heterotrophic_dominated),
             length(ID_unconnected_L_heterotrophic) * length(ID_unconnected_S_autotrophic))

expect_equal(nrow(combinations_equally_dominated),
             length(ID_unconnected_M_autotrophic) * length(ID_unconnected_M_heterotrophic))

expect_equal(nrow(combinations_autotrophic_dominated),
             length(ID_unconnected_L_autotrophic) * length(ID_unconnected_S_heterotrophic))

expect_equal(nrow(combinations_unconnected),
             nrow(combinations_autotrophic_dominated) + 
             nrow(combinations_heterotrophic_dominated) + 
             nrow(combinations_equally_dominated))
```

```{r unconnected-and-metaeco-system-join}

## - (4) Bind connected and unconnected meta-ecosystem combinations. - ##

ecosystem_combinations = rbind(combinations_connected,
                               combinations_unconnected) %>%
  mutate(connection = ifelse(str_detect(metaecosystem_type, "unconnected"),
                             "unconnected",
                             "connected"),
         ecosystems_combined = paste0(ID_first_ecosystem, "|", ID_second_ecosystem))
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
expect_equal(nrow(ecosystem_combinations), 
             nrow(combinations_unconnected) + nrow(combinations_connected))
```

```{r}

## - (5) Create ds_metaecosystems. - ##

row_i = 0
for (combination in 1 : nrow(ecosystem_combinations)) {
  for (time_p in time_points) {
    
    row_i = row_i + 1
    
    ds_metaecosystems[[row_i]] = ds_ecosystems %>%
      filter(ecosystem_ID %in% c(ecosystem_combinations[combination, ]$ID_first_ecosystem,
                                 ecosystem_combinations[combination, ]$ID_second_ecosystem),
             time_point == time_p) %>%
      group_by(time_point,
               day,
               metaecosystem_type,
               size,
               connection,
               size_effects) %>%
      summarise(total_metaecosystem_bioarea_mm2 = sum(bioarea_tot_mm2)) %>%
      mutate(
             
             # To know on which day the meta-ecosystem was sampled, select the sampling day that is time_p + 1. This is because the first sampling day is at time point 0, so all the days are shifted of 1 on place (e.g., the sampling day of time point 1 is at sampling_days[2]). 
             
             system_nr = ecosystem_combinations[combination, ]$system_nr,
             ecosystems_combined = ecosystem_combinations[combination, ]$ecosystems_combined) %>%
      rename(size = size) %>%
      ungroup()
  }
}

ds_metaecosystems = ds_metaecosystems %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(!system_nr %in% metaecosystems_to_take_off)
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
expect_equal(nrow(ds_metaecosystems), 
             length(time_points) * nrow(ecosystem_combinations))
```
